supported_budget_seconds.description: CD-0038 D3: the operation's declared seconds ceiling, typed on every budget_refused error so the recovery value a caller needs is never buried in details. Carried on no other kind.

consequenceSummary.description: CD-0037: the typed approval prompt, derived at challenge mint from the exact digest, consequence, scope, versions, and expiry the challenge binds. Required whenever the core minted a challenge; an approval_required refusal that minted nothing carries none. Caller-authored prose may not enter.
